duration.text: The Stomatology at Tongji University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3986 USD/per year ￥ 28700 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Transcript of undergraduate school5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents.7. Copy of article or papers published Catalogue and abstract of published paper, and other documents that can prove academic ability, and special documents required by the target college.8. Study plan Research or study plan in China

requirements.text: 1. Self-supporting students: applicants aged between 18 and 35 (up to and including December 31 in the year of application)Non-Chinese citizens who have graduated from high school or above and are in good health;2. Applicants who are immigrants from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan (China) and are a foreign national, or whose par ents are both Chinese citizens and have settled abroad, or who have been a foreign national since birth must meet the requirements of the Ministry of Education's Jiao Wai Han [2020] No.12;3. Applicants under the age of 18 (before August 31 in the current year) should click here to view the requirements.4. Proof of language proficiencyCertificate of HSK5 Chinese Proficiency Test with a score of 180 (inclusive) or above (valid for 2 years).※ Chinese Language of The International School (Economic and Trade/International Education) undergraduate entrance requirements:First year: New HSK Level 4, 180 points or above;Second year (transferred student): New HSK Level 4, 210 points (inclusive) or more, one year of Chinese learning experience (only Chinese language courses or undergraduate majors taught in Chinese at a college are accepted);Third year (transferred student): New HSK Level 5, 210 points (inclusive) or more, two years of Chinese learning experience (only Chinese language courses or undergraduate majors taught in Chinese at a college are accepted).(For applicants who attended a high school taught in Chinese, the teaching certificate in Chinese is required and the HSK certificate is not required.)
